resources.string: Put a widget or an app in this slot
Widgets: pick several, then tap Place · Apps: tap to open now · tap the backdrop to close
Tap an app to open it FULL SCREEN · press HOME to come back to Kachi · tap the backdrop to close
A slot holds at most %1$d items — remove one to add another
Drag the middle of a frame to move it · drag the bottom-right corner to resize. Frames always snap to the grid.
More than %1$d frames — this build supports %1$d at most.
%1$d empty cells left (the wallpaper shows through there)
%1$d frames already — a later build will raise the cap
Put photos in the Kachi photo folder
Current profile: %1$s. Tap to switch profile.
No profiles yet — open Settings → Driver profiles to add one.
Every launcher setting lives here — pick a group in the left column.
Kachi is re-requesting it — nothing for you to do
An environment limitation, not an app fault
The system is asking \"Allow USB debugging?\" — tick \"Always allow\", then OK, so Kachi can put apps into slots.
"Auto" means dark from 18:00 to 06:00. Changing the palette rebuilds the screen once.
Blurs what is behind each card for a true glass effect. Runs only on newer head units (Android 12+); older ones fall back to the lighter fake glass. Applies next time the screen opens.
Using the built-in default car image. To use your own car photo, follow the steps below.

How to change the car image (top-down view, transparent background works best):
1. Plug a USB stick into the car, or open the Files app.
2. Copy the image into this folder: %1$s
3. The newest image in the folder is used; reopen the home screen to see it.
Tap the button below to copy the folder path.

Saved with the current profile. "From wallpaper" takes the dominant colour of the first photo in the wallpaper folder. Text always stays readable: on a very light accent the button text turns dark by itself. Changing the colour rebuilds the screen once.
"By car" follows the system language: a Vietnamese system gets Vietnamese, anything else gets English. Changing the language rebuilds the screen once.

Each profile keeps its OWN copy of nearly everything: layout, slot contents, button bar, chips, wallpaper, theme, units, language and even the navigation settings. Tap a profile to switch to it — the profile chip on the top bar switches too, but creating and deleting happen only here.
%1$s · tap to switch to this profile
"Last used" starts with whichever profile was active when you switched the engine off. Pin a specific profile and every engine start returns to it, even if you switched profile on the previous trip.

Every setting in Settings — except System and permissions, the cluster casting geometry, and About — is saved for profile «%1$s». Switch to another profile in Driver profiles and the layout, slot contents, chips, button bar, theme and units all change with it.
Recirculate cabin air on engine start
The car forgets this mode on every start. ⚠ The command is unverified on a car — it may be rejected.
All permissions granted. Kachi re-requests them every time it opens, in case the system revoked them.
Kachi re-requests what it can; the rest states exactly what you need to do.
Not yet — the system is using %1$s.
Stop using Kachi as home screen
Cleared — press Home to go to the other launcher.
Kachi removed as home screen. No other launcher found — the system will pick one.
Done — press Home to return to Kachi.
On = use the Vietnamese model to hear "kachi" (no samples). Off = use KWS.

Say the wake phrase to open voice commands, no tap needed. Listens in the background while the screen is on. Off by default (uses battery/CPU). Experimental — it may not recognise you well yet; please report problems.
Hey Kachi turned off after too many false triggers. Re-enable in Settings.
Needs the shell channel — see the \"Window control channel\" row above.
The command ran but the system still isn\'t using Kachi: %1$s
Keep Kachi as home screen on engine start
On engine start, reassert Kachi as the home screen once if the system changed it. Off by default.
On engine start Kachi rebuilds its slots. Setting it as the home screen lives in the \"Home screen\" section above. Switched off, you open it by hand.
Kachi — a home screen for BYD DiLink cars.
MIT licence. A personal experiment, NOT affiliated with BYD.
Put photos in the Kachi photo folder

How to add WALLPAPER photos:
1. Plug a USB stick into the car, or open the Files app.
2. Copy photos into this folder: %1$s
3. Turn on the switch above — the photos become the wallpaper and cycle on a timer.
(Photos for the "Photo slideshow" widget go in a DIFFERENT folder — see the Photo slideshow section.)
Tap the button below to copy the folder path.

Photos for the "Photo slideshow" widget (a DIFFERENT folder from the wallpaper):
1. Plug a USB stick into the car, or open the Files app.
2. Copy photos into this folder: %1$s
3. Place the "Photo slideshow" widget in a slot — the photos cycle there.
Tap the button below to copy the folder path.
Turn off to hide the bar; the frames fill the whole screen
Tap a tile to add or remove a button from the bar.
Rearrange the clock, car chips and buttons on the status bar.
Rearrange the buttons you picked above.
⚠ Safety / Drivetrain / Entertainment groups change car behaviour.
Up to %1$d readings fit next to the clock. Tap a tile to switch it.
The top bar holds only %1$d chips — remove one first
No photos yet. Put photos in:\n%1$s
Android widgets drawn by other apps (clock, calendar, music…). Tap one to put it in this tile.
No app on this device provides a widget.
Could not allocate a widget tile — try again later.
The system channel is not connected yet, so widget permission could not be requested. Try again after reopening Kachi.
This car will not allow widgets from other apps. Built-in cards and groups still work normally.
The %1$s widget is gone — the app was uninstalled or disabled. Tap to pick another.
Pick the buttons for the car bar
Tap to add or remove a tile on the button bar · pick as many as you like · tap Apply to save
Couldn\'t open settings. Go to Settings → Apps → Special access → Notification access → enable ClusterNav.
Cluster cast off · cluster back to gauges
Enabled. Press the mapped button to open the app.
Accessibility granted but the service isn\'t bound yet (car under load) — retry in a few seconds, or toggle it in system Settings > Accessibility.
Couldn\'t enable accessibility — tap Allow USB debugging on the car and retry, or enable it in Settings > Accessibility.
Button saved. Pick an app, then tap “Add binding”.
Keep this screen open, then press the physical button…
Assistant set to Google/Gemini. Long-press mic to TALK (not open app).
Open the screen to check for updates.
Save home, work… then say “go home”, “to the office”, “go to <name>”. The book follows the active profile.
The book is full at %1$d entries — delete one first.
Both a name and an address are needed to save.
With coordinates VietMap can route there too. To get them: open a map app, press and hold the spot, then copy the pair of numbers.
Left indicator → left camera overlay on the left; right → right. Not car-verified.
Turn the defroster on when it rains
Reads the rain sensor every 5 minutes; turns the front and rear windscreen defrosters on while it rains and off again afterwards.
Only switches off a defroster Kachi turned on itself. If you turn it on, Kachi leaves it alone; if you turn it off mid-shower, Kachi will not turn it back on.
At the right time on the right day, opens your navigation app to a saved address. Each window navigates once per day.
You already have %1$d schedules — delete one before adding another.
There is no saved address to navigate to yet. Add one under "Address book" above first.
Not saved: the times need to read HH:mm, the end time must not be earlier than the start (no crossing midnight), and at least one day must be ticked.
Only navigate once GPS is available (wait until out of the car park)
Turning this on grants notification access through the car\'s own channel — no system settings needed.
Names wider than the cluster scroll across instead of being cut off.
Read from VietMap; turning it on starts VietMap once so there is a speed source.
A second, smaller badge for the road ahead.
Drag the badge inside the frame to place it on the cluster; the −/+ buttons above nudge it 10 px at a time.
Show the VietMap bubble on the cluster
The small turn-by-turn box drawn by the modified VietMap build.
The position only moves while the cluster is casting — it is still saved, but the cluster will not follow yet.
Turn on the bubble switch above to adjust the position.
Drag the box inside the frame to place the bubble on the cluster.
Opens the cluster so it can host app windows. Turning it off hands the cluster back to the gauges.
The Kachi blossom that floats over the screen; tap it to cast. Turning this off only hides the button — you can still cast with the four Cast-now buttons below, by voice, and on engine start.
On engine start, one app takes the whole cluster. Mutually exclusive with split auto-cast.
On engine start, two apps take one half each. Mutually exclusive with full auto-cast.
No app on this device can be cast to the cluster yet.
Ready · tap the bubble to cast
Hand the cluster back to the gauges
This stops casting, force-stops apps fighting over the cluster and resets the cluster display settings. It cannot be undone.
Cleaned: stopped casting + force-stopped %1$s + reset cluster. Please UNINSTALL DashCast and power-cycle.
Turning this on re-grants the accessibility service through the car\'s own channel.
Voice key: DISCONNECTED — tap Check / Fix now
No buttons bound yet. Tap “Add binding…” to link a physical button to an app.
There is no button to bind yet.
No app on this device can be opened from a button yet.
No buttons learned yet. Tap “Learn a new key…” then press the button on the steering wheel.
Name the button you just pressed
The car applies the level you set for each seat once the cabin temperature calls for it.
Tap a seat to change its level: off → level 1 → level 2.
Purify automatically when the air is dirty
The car runs the purifier when the dust level rises; turn it off to purify only on demand.
Run the navigation/cluster service in the background on engine start
DIFFERENT from the row above: that one opens the Kachi screen, this one only starts the service without any screen.

Lets a computer connected over adb send test commands to Kachi (say a phrase, switch profile, put an app in a slot, read the state). Only turn this on while you are in the car and testing. It switches itself off after 60 minutes and after the engine is switched off.
On — %1$d minutes left. Every command that arrives is written to the log and to Kachi\'s test folder.
Disclaimer: this is a personal experiment, NOT affiliated with BYD. It comes with no warranty of driving safety, compatibility or reliability. Install and use at your own risk.
Kachi is a personal experiment, NOT affiliated with BYD. It comes with no warranty of driving safety, compatibility, or reliability. Install and use at your own risk.
Centre + ETA: showing on the cluster
Centre + ETA: Cast on — navigation yields the cluster
Centre + ETA: command not delivered (check the 5555 link)
DPI applies to the WHOLE cluster, not to one slot (a wm density limit on Android 10).

resources.string: Type a sentence exactly as you would say it, to see what the parser understands — e.g. “turn on reading light”, “set temperature 22”, “close all”, “show battery”, “open Settings”. To actually speak, use the “Talk to car” tile on the control bar or the mic button on the top bar.
A listening session starts from the home screen (the “Talk to car” tile or the mic button on the top bar), not from this trial box.
Not installed. The Vietnamese model (%1$s) has to be downloaded once; after that speech is recognised on the car itself and never leaves it.
A new version of the "%1$s" model is available — tap Update to download it.
On the last start Kachi skipped preloading the model (%1$s), so the first tap on the mic will take longer.
Not installed. The Vietnamese voice pack (%1$s) is downloaded once; after that Kachi speaks its replies on the car itself, with no network and no Google.
A new version of \"%1$s\" is available — tap Update to download it.
No network on the car: copy the whole pack tree into Android/data/%1$s/files/sherpa/import/%2$s/ and press Download — every file is still sha256-checked.
Kachi reads its answer aloud instead of only showing it.
Only takes effect once the voice pack is installed; until then the system speech engine is used.
Put kachi-voice-test.wav (16 kHz · mono · 16-bit PCM) in one of: %1$s
Off keeps just the icon and the number — more room on the bar
Kachi runs straight away by default. Tick anything you want it to ask about first.
Speaks first, then opens the mic — only matters once something is ticked
Change this if the mic hears poorly. \"Automatic\" tries MIC first, then the noise-cancelled source.
Could not rename — the name is empty or already used
Mic button on the status bar
Speak a command quickly, next to Apps and Settings
Walk through every readout and action on the car. For an ACTION: tap Run, then mark OK or Not OK. For a READOUT: check the value shown. Results are saved so you can verify everything on the car.
Could not send (off-car or the button is unmapped).
⚠ This moves body hardware (windows/doors/tailgate). Make sure it is safe before running.
Camera overlay appears on the cluster instead of the main screen
